Select all IC50 activity rows for human amine oxidase [flavin-containing] B (CHEMBL2039). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to retrieve pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
